title: EA4LLM: A Gradient-Free Approach to Large Language Model Optimization via Evolutionary Algorithms
description_en: Full-parameter ES pretraining that uses mean next-token log-probability as fitness; demonstrated on Qwen3-style models from 0.5B to 32B parameters.

title: DART-ES: Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Fine-Tuning LLMs with Evolution Strategies
description_en: Uses population pass rates and historical difficulty estimates to reweight rewards and replay rarely solved samples during forward-only full-parameter ES fine-tuning; evaluated on mathematical reasoning, instruction tuning, code generation, and Countdown.
description_zh: 在纯前向全参数 ES 微调中，根据种群通过率和历史难度估计重加权奖励并重放罕见可解样本；评测覆盖数学推理、指令微调、代码生成和 Countdown。
